name: Repomix Action
description: Pack repository contents into a single file that is easy for LLMs to process

directories.description: Space-separated list of directories to process (defaults to '.')

output.description: Relative path to write packed file

compress.description: Set to 'false' to disable smart compression

additional-args.description: Any extra raw arguments to pass directly to the repomix CLI

repomix-version.description: Version (or tag) of the npm package to install – defaults to latest
